title: 第25章 青鱼成为剑门特招外门弟子第26章 剑门长老 惊喜不断
content_zh:
剑门长老看郑风一个初阶武君，将一个高阶武君的李飞龙轰飞，这个可是个技术活。
飞得高、飞得远、飞得轻盈、落地还毫发无伤，这已经不是实力碾压的问题，而是剑道高深，力道精准掌控。
如同大人教训自家小孩，给了惩戒还不忍伤害，这份豁达和宽容，与年龄十分不合。
正是这份不和，才难能可贵。
长老颔首示意许可，期待郑风推荐的四位少年接下来的表现。
“青鱼、郑杰、沐浩天、妙沁阳，你们上台来。”郑风朗声喊上四位。天团少年好多人才知道，沐沐的原名叫沐浩天。
沐沐的父亲沐阁主和娘亲景瑞公主听到郑风喊出这个名字也是也是十分激动，这个名字在神界众人面前被叫了出来，是多么有面子的事情。郑风推荐沐沐做剑门外门弟子是事先没有说过的。
四位少年上台整齐的站到郑风身边。
“哇！个个都是帅哥，都说人以类聚，郑风一伙个个都是靓仔！”
人群中早就热闹起来。郑风成了剑门弟子后，很多之前出声刁难的都回头来跟着追捧。
“大伙看到他们人帅吧？”郑风指着四位，一脸阳光亲切地询问台下的人群。
“帅！”很多声音回答，炼体的郑杰高大魁梧英武俊朗，青鱼、沐浩天、妙沁阳都是身材修长神采飞扬。
“他们帅但绝不是绣花枕头！”郑风的调侃引得一众天才大笑。剑门长老和几位弟子都忍俊不禁。
“我为大伙介绍一下，他们两位左边的帅哥是沐浩天，右边的帅哥是妙沁阳。不过他们两个需要准备一下。”
“青鱼修行阵道，郑杰修行炼体。青鱼先展示你的阵道，随后郑杰展示炼体。”众人很是期待，剑们很少看到展示剑术以外的阵道和炼体。
“烦请长老和师兄们把关，考核一下。”郑风回身恭请剑门长老和李飞龙等几位剑门弟子。
众人都把目光聚焦到青鱼身上时，青鱼知道这是郑风为他争取的机会，很是感动，郑风并没有把他当跟班，而是为他争取外门弟子的资格。
青鱼心里激动又有些忐忑，怕辜负了郑风的信任。
“青鱼相信自己的实力，加油！”郑风和青鱼握手，顺便递给青鱼一枚戒指。
“为你定制的阵盘，认主后自由发挥！”郑风轻声在青鱼耳边提醒，眼神尽是鼓励。

青鱼感受了自己储物戒的资源很快有了主意。
“青鱼主修阵道，由于时间匆忙，就临时布下一个简单的组合大阵，随后有兴趣的朋友可以上来试试，看能不能攻破。”青鱼取出阵盘，挥手之间，阵盘出，青鱼的一滴血珠向阵盘中心就打了进去。
阵盘滴血认主，青鱼神念催动，顿时光芒大放。
布阵材料，行云流水的挥洒，五分之一炷香的时间，高台上一个以阵盘为阵眼，孩儿山陨石为阵点的“十方阵”顷刻布好。
万殿主看到也是眼前一亮。
郑风能让青鱼出手，自是做了万全的准备，青鱼对“十方阵”已经琢磨了很久，郑风早就传授过心得，阵盘可以说是完成了”十方阵“的主体。
青鱼的布阵手法娴熟，流程顺畅，十分华丽，让剑门的几位弟子看得眼花缭乱，就是长老也是频频点头。
郑风看到沐沐和妙沁阳拿到自己给的药材时，也是瞠目结舌，他们身上肯定有药材，但和神界的比较就相差太多，因此，郑风在康昊外婆家买的药材就起了很大的作用，郑风是按照丹方配好的药材，二位只要熟悉后就能炼制。
康昊这时明白了，郑风买下药材是为了沐沐和沁阳。
“多好的孩子！”景瑞公主和沐阁主、妙仙子都十分感动。
青鱼的布阵赢得了众人的喝彩，随后有好几位武君上来，开始是单人轮番攻击，后来几位高阶武君一起挥剑攻击，大阵纹丝不动。
“青鱼修为不高，武君都不是，顷刻布下的大阵却能同时承受几位高阶武君的攻击。”
“剑的攻击以犀利锋锐着称，都未能将大阵撼动分毫！”
众人惊呼出声，纷纷鼓掌叫好。
“大伙都看到了，威能不同凡响！”长老环视四周，众人都十分信服。
“青鱼的阵道天赋的确值得剑门破例特招。“
”恭喜青鱼成为剑门正式外门弟子。”长老朗声宣布，心情不错，眉开眼笑。
”青鱼谢过长老的赏识！“
”恭喜青鱼成为剑门正式外门弟子。”李飞龙大声祝贺。
“恭喜青鱼师弟！接下来请郑杰上前展示炼体天赋。”

郑风欣喜地看着青鱼，鼓励郑杰展示自己。

content_en:
The elders of Jianmen watched Zheng Feng, a junior Martial Lord, blow away Li Feilong, a high-level Martial Lord. This was quite a technical feat.
Flying high, flying far, flying light, and landing unscathed, this is no longer a matter of crushing strength, but a matter of profound swordsmanship and precise control of strength.
Just like an adult teaching his own child and not being able to bear harm even after being punished, this open-mindedness and tolerance are very inconsistent with his age.
It is this discord that is so valuable.
The elder nodded in approval and looked forward to the next performance of the four young men recommended by Zheng Feng.
"Qingyu, Zheng Jie, Mu Haotian, Miao Qinyang, come on stage." Zheng Feng shouted loudly to the four of them. Many young people in Tiantuan know that Mu Mu’s original name is Mu Haotian.
Mu Mu's father, Pavilion Master Mu, and mother, Princess Jingrui, were also very excited when they heard Zheng Feng call out this name. It was such a honor to have this name called out in front of everyone in the God Realm. Zheng Feng's recommendation of Mu Mu to be an outer disciple of the Sword Sect was not mentioned in advance.
The four teenagers came on stage and stood neatly next to Zheng Feng.
"Wow! They are all handsome guys. They say that people of the same species flock together, and Zheng Feng and his gang are all handsome guys!"
The crowd had already become lively. After Zheng Feng became a disciple of Jianmen, many who had previously made things difficult for him came back to follow him.
"Don't you see how handsome they are?" Zheng Feng pointed at the four of them and asked the crowd in the audience cordially with a sunny look on his face.
"Handsome!" Many voices replied. Zheng Jie, who was training, was tall and tall, strong and handsome, while Qing Yu, Mu Haotian and Miao Qinyang were all slender and energetic.
"They are handsome, but they are definitely not embroidered pillows!" Zheng Feng's joke made the geniuses laugh. The Jianmen elders and several disciples couldn't help laughing.
"Let me introduce to everyone, the handsome guy on the left is Mu Haotian, and the handsome guy on the right is Miao Qinyang. But they two need to prepare."
"Qing Yu practices the formation, and Zheng Jie practices the body. Qing Yu shows you the formation first, and then Zheng Jie shows the body." Everyone is looking forward to it. Swordsmen rarely see formations and body refining other than swordsmanship.
"Please ask the elders and senior brothers to check and do the assessment." Zheng Feng turned around and respectfully invited the Jianmen elders, Li Feilong and other Jianmen disciples.
When everyone focused their attention on Qingyu, Qingyu knew that this was the opportunity Zheng Feng had fought for for him, and was very moved. Zheng Feng did not treat him as a follower, but instead fought for his qualifications as an outer disciple.
Qingyu was excited and a little nervous, fearing that he would betray Zheng Feng's trust.
"Qingyu believes in his own strength, come on!" Zheng Feng shook hands with Qingyu and handed Qingyu a ring.
"The array is customized for you, feel free to use it after you recognize the master!" Zheng Feng reminded Qingyu softly in his ear, his eyes full of encouragement.
Qingyu felt the resources of his storage ring and quickly came up with an idea.
"Qingyu majors in formations. Due to the rush of time, he temporarily set up a simple combination formation. Later, interested friends can come up and try to see if they can break through." Qingyu took out the formation disk, waved his hand, and the formation disk came out. A drop of Qingyu's blood hit the center of the formation disk.
The array plate dripped blood to recognize its master, and the Qingyu divine mind activated, and the light suddenly shone brightly.
Arrangement of materials, flowing water, and one-fifth of the time of burning incense, a "ten square array" with the array disk as the eye and the Boyer Mountain meteorite as the point was instantly set up on the high platform.
Palace Master Wan's eyes lit up when he saw it.
Zheng Feng was able to make Qingyu take action, so he was fully prepared. Qingyu had been thinking about the "Ten Square Formation" for a long time, and Zheng Feng had already taught him his experience. The formation plate can be said to have completed the main body of the "Ten Square Formation".
Qingyu's formation was skillful, smooth and gorgeous, which dazzled several disciples of Jianmen. Even the elders nodded frequently.
Zheng Feng was also dumbfounded when he saw Mu Mu and Miao Qinyang getting the medicinal materials he gave them. They must have medicinal materials on them, but they were far different from those in the God Realm. Therefore, the medicine Zheng Feng bought at Kang Hao's grandma's houseThe ingredients play a big role. Zheng Feng prepared the medicinal ingredients according to the elixir recipe. As long as the two of you are familiar with it, you can refine it.
Kang Hao understood at this time that Zheng Feng bought the medicinal materials for Mu Mu and Qinyang.
"What a wonderful child!" Princess Jingrui, Pavilion Master Mu, and Fairy Miao were all very moved.
Qingyu's formation won applause from everyone, and then several Martial Lords came up. At first, they attacked individually, and then several high-level Martial Lords attacked together with their swords. The formation did not move at all.
"Qingyu's cultivation level is not high, and he is not even a Martial Lord. However, the large formation he set up in an instant can withstand the attacks of several high-level Martial Lords at the same time."
"The sword's attacks are known for their sharpness, but they failed to shake the formation at all!"
Everyone exclaimed and applauded.
"Everyone has seen it, its power is extraordinary!" The elder looked around, and everyone was very convinced.
"Qingyu's formation talent is indeed worthy of Jianmen's special move."
"Congratulations Qingyu for becoming an official outer disciple of Jianmen." The elder announced loudly, feeling good and smiling.
"Qingyu thanks the elder for his appreciation!"
"Congratulations Qingyu for becoming an official outer disciple of Jianmen." Li Feilong congratulated loudly.
"Congratulations to Junior Brother Qingyu! Next, I invite Zheng Jie to come forward and demonstrate his talent in body training."
Zheng Feng looked at Qingyu with joy and encouraged Zheng Jie to show himself.
